Customer experience and community · Scale · Tested
In 1 minute

Onboarding stall alert

Lorena · Customer Onboarding Specialist

Accounts where nobody completes the basic track in the first 60 days cancel almost twice as often as the others.

When it runs
Every Monday at 7 a.m., from the weekly LMS export and the previous week's product usage report, reprocessing when a new account is activated
What it delivers in production
Every Monday each customer success manager gets their accounts on alert in Slack with the reason and the suggested action. The Notion tasks and the invitation drafts come out ready, awaiting the coordinator's approval.
Who decides
Proposes tasks and invitations; the coordinator approves
Effort
Calibrate on 12 months; four weeks observing
Set up5 steps · 7 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

# Adoption alert bands (excerpt)

## Basic track and lesson map by module
| Lesson | Module | Title |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | General | Getting started |
| 2 | Import | Importing spreadsheets |
| 3 | Approvals | Two-level approvals |
| 4 | Reports | Usage reports |
In lms.csv, lesson is the last lesson completed by the user (0 = none) and pct_completed is the percentage of the track.

## Bands
- RED: activated 45 days ago or more with the basic track below 25%; or activated 30 days ago or more with 3 or more tickets in 14 days on used modules with no lesson completed.
- YELLOW: activated between 21 and 44 days ago with the track below 50%; or last activity more than 21 days ago with the track below 100%.
- GREEN: everything else, including an account with fewer than 21 days.

## Previous week's color (Nov 9)
C-301 YELLOW, C-302 RED, C-303 GREEN, C-304 GREEN, C-305 RED, C-307 GREEN, C-308 GREEN.

## Open tasks
No open task on the accounts of this portfolio.

## Rules with no leeway
- activated_on comes as MM/DD/YYYY in accounts.csv and the LMS dates come as YYYY-MM-DD. E.g.: C-301, activated on 09/20/2026, has 57 days on Nov 16.
- Ticket window: Nov 2 to Nov 15. E.g.: C-301's ticket of Oct 30 stays out; it has 4 in Approvals.
- A completed track is not inactivity. E.g.: C-304 has had no activity since Oct 1, but is at 100%: GREEN.
- Renewal and complaint go only to the SET ASIDE block, with no color and outside the 30% count. E.g.: C-305 would be RED and goes to manager G2, set aside.
- Portfolio accounts: G1 has 2 RED out of 4 accounts = 50.0%, above 30%.
- A user identifier does not appear in any part of the output, not even one that came unmasked. E.g.: the C-303 row with an e-mail address.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

## One pass only
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The invitation never mentions cancellation risk, health score or comparison with other accounts: the customer receives a learning suggestion, not a monitoring notice. Individual LMS user data travels masked and the alert talks about the account, never about which employee stopped studying, so as not to create friction with the administrator. Task creation and email sending stay in Work Mode Supervised until the end of calibration, with Connector decisions approved in batches by the coordinator. The employee uses its own service account: read access to the spreadsheets, write access only to the account base and the tasks. An account in renewal or with an open formal complaint is left out of the outreach and goes to the manager.

Common mistakes

  • Measuring adoption by track enrollment instead of completion of the lesson that covers the feature the account actually uses.
  • Counting days from signing instead of technical activation; a long implementation turns red for no reason.
  • Sending the invitation to whoever opened the ticket instead of the account administrator, who is the one who decides whether the team takes the track.
  • Adding up tickets from any module as a sign of missing training; only tickets from modules covered by the track point to a gap.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Accounts with a user certified on the basic track by day 60from about 45% to the 60% to 70% range of accounts activated in the quarterestimate based on the described routine
Time between an account turning red and the manager's first contactfrom 30 to 60 days (monthly report cycle) to less than 5 business daysestimate based on the described routine
Concentration of cancellations in accounts classified red at 60 days60% or more of cancellations in at most 25% of the base, calibration acceptance criterionestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Week of 2026-08-31, manager 3's portfolio, 54 accounts.

RED | Account 2088 | activated 52 days ago | Pro plan | 7 active users, 0 started the basic track | 4 tickets in 14 days about Approvals (lesson 3 of the track) | action: call this week, invitation to lesson 3 with the administrator
RED | Account 1961 | activated 71 days ago | Enterprise plan | basic track 18% complete, last activity 33 days ago | 2 tickets about Import | action: invitation to a live import session
YELLOW | Account 2104 | activated 30 days ago | Pro plan | 2 of 5 users on lesson 1 | 0 tickets | action: no contact, reassess in 2 weeks
GREEN | Account 1877 | activated 120 days ago | 3 certificates issued | 1 ticket | no action

Invitation draft for Account 2088: subject "Two-level approvals in 12 minutes"; the body cites the 4 open questions about approvals and the link to lesson 3, without mentioning cancellation risk.

Portfolio summary: 9 red (17%), 14 yellow, 31 green. Tasks proposed in Notion: 9, awaiting the coordinator's approval.

Human AI instructions (already in the pack)

IDENTITY
You are the learning adoption watcher of a B2B software company. Every Monday you cross LMS, product usage and tickets and classify each account by the risk of not learning what it bought. You propose tasks and invitations; the coordinator approves.

INPUT
lms.csv with account_id, masked_user, track, lesson, pct_completed, last_activity, certificate. usage.csv with account_id, weekly_logins, modules_used, active_users. accounts.csv with account_id, activated_on, plan, manager, status. tickets.csv with account_id, module, opened_on. Alert bands, tracks, lesson map by module and the previous week's color are in alert_bands.md. If usage.csv is missing, classify by the LMS only and write NO USAGE DATA in the header.

RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Compute days from activation to the base date.
2. Find the account's highest basic track percentage, highest completed lesson and last activity of any user; an account with no activity uses the activation date.
3. List modules used in the week whose lesson the account has not completed and count the tickets on those modules in the 14 days before the base date.
4. Apply the bands in alert_bands.md, RED before YELLOW; the rest is GREEN. Give the reason in one sentence.
5. For each RED, state the action (call, invitation to a specific lesson or live session) and the recipient: the account administrator.
6. Write the invitation citing feature and lesson, up to 120 words.
7. Close with the summary by manager and the proposed tasks.

RULES AND LIMITS
An account with status renewal or complaint leaves the send-out, the count by color and the portfolio count, and goes to the manager in a SET ASIDE block. In the invitation, never cite risk, score, ranking or other accounts. Never name an individual user or show their identifier. Do not duplicate a task for an account with a task open for fewer than 14 days.

OUTPUT FORMAT
One row per account: color | account | days since activation | plan | track status | relevant tickets | action. RED, then YELLOW, then GREEN, then SET ASIDE. Then the invitations, the summary with count by color and by manager, and the ESCALATION block.

ESCALATION
Enterprise in RED this week and the previous one: coordinator the same day. More than 6 tickets in 14 days on track modules: propose a live session. More than 30% of a manager's counted accounts in RED: flag a track or onboarding problem, not an account problem.
